extName.description: Extension name. Keep the brand name as is.

extDescription.message: Se dina vänners loggar högst upp på varje cachesida på Geocaching.com. Slipp leta igenom loggboken för att hitta dem.
extDescription.description: Store summary and extension description. 132 characters or fewer.

ratingPromptText.message: Har du nytta av Friends Logs? Ett snabbt betyg i butiken hjälper andra geocachare att hitta det.
ratingPromptText.description: Rating prompt shown once on the cache page, under the friends' logs, after a few cache pages with logs. Keep the name Friends Logs as is.

ratingPromptRate.description: Button in the rating prompt on the cache page that opens the store page to leave a rating.

ratingPromptDismiss.description: Button in the rating prompt on the cache page that dismisses the prompt for good.

popupShowFriends.description: Popup toggle that shows the friends' logs at the top of cache pages.

popupShowFriendsHint.message: Lyft fram loggar från din vänlista
popupShowFriendsHint.description: Popup hint under the friends' logs toggle.

popupShowMine.description: Popup toggle that shows the user's own logs at the top of cache pages.

popupShowMineHint.message: Lyft fram dina egna loggar på cachesidor
popupShowMineHint.description: Popup hint under the own logs toggle.

popupLimitLabel.description: Popup label for the menu that picks how many friends' logs to show.

popupLimitOption.description: Option in the popup limit menu. COUNT is 5, 10, 20, 50 or 100.

popupLimitHint.description: Popup hint under the limit menu.

popupRate.description: Popup footer link to the store page to rate the extension.

popupReport.description: Popup footer link to the GitHub issues page.

cacheFriendsLog.description: Header on the cache page above a single friend log.

cacheFriendsLogs.description: Header on the cache page above the friends' logs when there are 0 or 2 or more. COUNT is the number of logs.

cacheMyLog.description: Header on the cache page above the user's own log when there is one.

cacheMyLogs.description: Header on the cache page above the user's own logs when there are several.

cacheLogbook.description: Header on the cache page above the site's own logbook, after the extension's logs.
